description: Read an app table across users: filters on declared fields, order, page, or just a count. e.g. { table: "reservas", where: { clase: "yoga-martes", estado: "confirmada" }, count: true }, or { table: "puntos", orderBy: "-score", limit: 10 }. Rows come with id, owner (the user id in the app), createdAt, updatedAt.

where.description: { field: value } or { field: { eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in } }, on declared fields

name: neblla_table_query
